title: Prequential E-Values for Selected-GP Near-Optimality Certificates
abstract: arXiv:2609.39123v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When optimizing an expensive black-box function sequentially, as in hyperparameter optimization, we may want to stop once the best evaluated value is certified within $\varepsilon$ of the global optimum. Such a certificate needs two ingredients: a lower confidence bound for the selected value and an upper confidence envelope over the domain, typically supplied by a Gaussian process (GP). GP-UCB-style stopping rules are valid when the kernel and constants defining this envelope are fixed before the run, but the practical temptation is to tune the envelope from the same adaptive evaluations and then certify as if it had been fixed. We use prequential e-values to make this selection auditable: starting from a predeclared set of fully specified GP/RKHS envelopes, each candidate is tested by its own one-step-ahead e-process, contradicted candidates are deleted, and certification uses the largest upper bound among the survivors. translated_title: 用于所选高斯过程近优性证书的预测序E值
translated_abstract: 当顺序优化一个昂贵的黑盒函数时（例如超参数优化），我们可能希望在最佳评估值被认证处于全局最优值的 $\varepsilon$ 范围内时停止。这样的证书需要两个要素：所选值的下置信界以及整个域上的上置信包络，后者通常由高斯过程（GP）提供。GP-UCB式的停止规则在定义该包络的核函数和常数在运行之前就已固定时是有效的，但实践中的诱惑是利用相同的自适应评估来调整包络，然后却把它当作已固定的情况来进行认证。我们使用预测序e值使这种选择变得可审计：从一个预先声明的、完全指定的GP/RKHS包络集合出发，每个候选包络由其自身的一步前瞻e过程进行检验，被否定的候选将被删除，而最终的认证则采用幸存者中最大的上界。
tldr: 该论文提出利用预测序e值使高斯过程上置信包络的自适应选择变得可审计，从而在昂贵黑盒优化（如超参数优化）中提供有效的近优性停止证书。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes using prequential e-values to make adaptive Gaussian process envelope selection auditable, enabling valid near-optimality stopping certificates in expensive black-box optimization such as hyperparameter optimization.
